I found nothing the contributor has to fix before merge.

**What I ran**
- `pnpm vitest run packages/tailwindcss` passed: 42 test files, 5017 tests passed and 1 skipped. That includes the new `anchor` and `anchored` tests and the updated IntelliSense snapshot, which now lists `anchor-none` and `anchored-auto`.
- `npx prettier --check` on the four changed source files and `CHANGELOG.md` reported "All matched files use Prettier code style!"
- `tsc --noEmit -p packages/tailwindcss` reported no errors in the changed files. The only errors are missing `@tailwindcss/oxide` type declarations in files this change doesn't touch.

**Checked against the issue**
- `anchor-tooltip` gives `anchor-name: --tooltip`, `anchor-none` gives `none`, and `anchor-[--a,--b]` passes through unchanged.
- `anchored-tooltip` gives `position-anchor: --tooltip`, `anchored-auto` gives `auto`, and `anchored-[--menu]` passes through unchanged.
- Bare `anchor` and `anchored`, the negative forms and any modifier all produce empty output, and the tests assert this.
- The code is in `utilities.ts`, the tests are in `utilities.test.ts`, and there's an entry under Unreleased in `CHANGELOG.md`. Adding both properties to `property-order.ts` is how the repo controls where new properties sort.

**Edge cases I tried** (with a temporary test file, now deleted; `git status` is the same as when I started)
- `anchor--foo` gives `---foo`, `anchor-1` gives `--1` and `anchor-_x` gives `--_x`. All three are valid dashed identifiers.
- `anchored-[auto]` gives `auto`, and `anchor-(--a)` gives `var(--a)`.
- `-anchor-none` and `anchor-none/50` produce empty output.

**Nits**
- The changelog entry has no PR link. Every other line in Unreleased has one, so add it once the PR number exists.
- `anchored-none` gives `position-anchor: --none`. The issue doesn't ask for a `none` keyword, so this matches it as written. But newer drafts of the spec add `none` to `position-anchor`, so it could become a surprise later.
- `anchor-auto` gives `--auto`. That's harmless because `anchor-name` has no `auto` keyword.
